[[File:DeuteriumRounds-SWGTCGAoD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Coret Bhan]] destroys a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] with explosive deuterium rounds]]
'''Deuterium''' was a type of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]]. It was used to power [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade's]] [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder]]. The fuel came packaged in a canister, which provided safe and compact transport.

Deuterium could also be harnessed as a weapon. They could be made into rounds fired from a projectile weapon which exploded on impact with the target. Deuterium was apparently an ingredient in the [[Deuterium-pyro]] drink.
